full_judgment: 2. The plaintiffs filed the suit for a declaration of title and recovery of khas possession in respect of 527 Sq. yards of land with a one storied building situated in Schedule II of Schedule I of the plaint. The suit land belonged to Peari Mohan Datta and others, from whom one Satish Chandra Chakravarty purchased and constructed a structure with his own money for carrying on business. He made a construction of an incomplete two storied building. He let out some parts to others and occupied himself some for the purpose of his business. One Protab Chandra Bhottacharjee purchased the properties by kabala from Satish Chandra Chakravarty on 1.3.54 and went into possession. As a precautionary measure he got another kabala executed on 20.6.54 and registered on 18.10.54 from Satish Chandra Chakravarty and his other co-sharers. Protab Chandra Bhottacharjee remained there in the building for few months and he went to his own house as the building was 30 miles away from his home. The building was kept under lock and key. Defendant Nos. 1-3 trespassed into the suit properties and wrongly dispossessed Protab Chandra Bhottacharjee. Subsequently by a kabala dated 12.11.62 Protab Chandra Bhattacharjee sold the suit land to the plaintiffs. The defendants having not vacated the house the suit was filed.
